findings.title: Refused confidence interval appears as an empty interval

evidence.quote: "detail": "Registered PM/HKSJ uses t(1)=12.71 at k=2; the interval is not served as a pooled confidence interval because a single degree of freedom is not reliable here."

findings.why: The Analysis table displays an interval label with blank endpoints without explaining the recorded refusal. Readers cannot distinguish deliberate withholding from missing data.
findings.fix: Replace the empty interval with a tab-reason displaying the recorded K2_SINGLE_DF refusal.

findings.title: Sentence-checking assurance exceeds recorded coverage
findings.page_quote: every other sentence on the page is checked against it.

evidence.quote:
"not_in_scope": [
      "verbatim source quotations",
      "external comparator prose without a committed object row"
    ]

findings.why: The review explicitly excludes some page prose from checking, contradicting the universal assurance.
findings.fix: Describe the recorded checking scope and its exclusions instead of claiming every sentence is checked.

findings.title: Forest plot labels a mixed HR/RR synthesis as HR
findings.why: The axis presents all estimates as hazard ratios, although the recorded synthesis combines two HRs and one RR. The Results tab preserves this qualification.
findings.fix: Use the recorded mixed-measure effect label and identify each trial's measure in the plot.

findings.title: Analysis omits the recorded refusal of the primary pool

evidence.quote: "detail": "k=2 pooled row refused because point estimates are on opposite sides of the null"

findings.why: The primary Analysis table shows blank interval endpoints and heterogeneity statistics without stating that the pool was refused for conflicting trial directions.
findings.fix: Display the recorded DIRECTION_CONFLICT_K2 refusal beside the individual-trial forest plot and omit empty pooled interval rows.
